description: Test-only build for #212. Netflix 13.0.1 build 25028 received re-minified ad code; this recovers the ad-kill (V3) and scans the large memory region the code now often sits in. Patch with the same patches as usual, then: force-stop, relaunch, wait ~60s on home, play a title, and attach `adb logcat -d -s KILL > kill.txt`. Success = `PATCH V3-ADV … verify=OK` and `PATCH V3-MASTER … verify=OK`.

patches.name: Disable auto-updates
patches.description: Prevents Google Play Store from automatically replacing the patched APK with the official unpatched version.

patches.name: Override certificate pinning
patches.description: Allows HTTPS traffic inspection tools like AdGuard Premium to intercept app connections. Enables consistent pre-roll suppression when used alongside AdGuard Premium.

patches.name: Prime Video extension

patches.name: Paramount+ Android TV

patches.name: Disney+ Android TV

patches.name: Skip ads
patches.description: Disables ad delivery via Sky SDK surgical targets (FreeWheel DI module skip, MediaTailor SSAI layers, ad-break-started no-op), AdBlockInterceptor wiring on both the app NetworkingKt OkHttp client and the Sky SDK addon network client, and a WebView shouldInterceptRequest wrapper. Validated v7.5.102 and v7.6.100.

patches.name: Skip ads
patches.description: Suppresses all ad delivery systems in Tubi Android TV.

patches.name: Skip ads
patches.description: Suppresses ViX ad delivery by disabling the FreeWheel ad provider at the config level and preventing the Innovid SSAI overlay from mounting.

patches.name: HBO Max - Disable Ads
patches.description: Suppresses nonlinear overlay ads (Bolt), SSAI linear ad timeline registration (GMSS/AdSparx), and live stream preroll ad timeline entry generation for all content types.
